In the meantime, the order dated 31.08.2023 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Vaishali at Hajipur in Criminal Revision No. 112 of 2023 whereby the order dated 18.04.2023 passed by the learned S.D.J.M, Vaishali at Hajipur in Mahila P.S. Case No. 15 of 2022 whereby cognizance was taken under Sections 498A and 34 of the IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the D.P. Act has been upheld, shall remain stayed, as it has been submitted that petitioner no. 1 is the unmarried sister-in-law of O.P. No. 2, petitioner no. 2 is brother-in-law of O.P. No. 2, petitioner no. 3 is elder sister-in-law (Jethani) of O.P. No. 2 and petitioner no. 4 is the elder brother-in-law of O.P. No. 2, it is further submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegation.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Rishabh/-
